what_it_does: This paper provides the first comprehensive performance evaluation of Cerebras WSE-2—a specialized AI chip with 900,000 computing cores densely packed on a single wafer (much larger than conventional chips). The researchers measure how fast it can perform computations, how much data it can move per second (memory bandwidth), the delay in communicating between different parts of the chip (communication latency), and the maximum data that can cross the middle of the network in one direction (bisection bandwidth). They also create a roofline model—a visual tool showing the practical limits on performance based on computation speed and memory bandwidth.
